fundamentals.name: Lennar Corporation
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Lennar Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a homebuilder primarily under the Lennar brand in the United States. It operates through Homebuilding East, Homebuilding Central, Homebuilding South Central, Homebuilding West, Financial Services, Multifamily, and Lennar Other segments. The company's homebuilding operations include the construction and sale of single-family attached and detached homes, as well as the purchase, development, and sale of residential land; and development, construction, and management of multifamily rental properties. It also offers residential mortgage financing, title insurance, and closing services for home buyers and others, as well as originating and selling securitization commercial mortgage loans. In addition, the company is involved in fund investment activities. It primarily serves first-time, move-up, active adult, and luxury homebuyers. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in Miami, Florida.

judgment.summary: A homebuilder with a solid balance sheet and cash flow, but facing headwinds from a declining housing market and negative growth.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed estimates; next earnings 2026-06-11.
positives: Forward P/E 11.79x — attractive valuation relative to earnings expectations.
PEG ratio 0.76 — suggests earnings growth may outpace the stock price.
Total cash $8.98B and Free cash flow (TTM) $3.44B — strong liquidity and cash generation.
Debt/Equity 24.99% and Current ratio 8.33 — healthy balance sheet.
Dividend yield 2.2% — provides income to shareholders.
negatives: Revenue growth -13.3% YoY and Earnings growth -52.6% YoY — significant top-line and bottom-line contraction.
Quarterly earnings growth -55.8% — recent performance is sharply negative.
Analyst growth est, current Q -34.3% and current FY -25.8% — continued negative growth expected.
Operating margin 3.6% and Profit margin 5.4% — margins are thin.
Beta 1.42 — stock is more volatile than the broader market.

news.paragraph: Lennar is approaching its Q2 earnings print with mixed signals from recent commentary. While one analyst is buying ahead of the print, citing opportunity in homebuilding, others note the company's stock is down as the broader U.S. housing market struggles. Lennar's evolving market strategy, including new community developments, may offer clues to its path forward.
